laplacian.title: Variance of Laplacian (Default / Fast)
laplacian.how_it_works: 🔬 How It Works: Measures grayscale edge variance using a 2D Laplacian operator (∇²I). Sharp images produce steep intensity transitions.
laplacian.detects: 🎯 Detects: General defocus blur and soft edge variance across the full photo.
laplacian.pros: ✅ Pros: Ultra-fast execution (< 3ms / photo), extremely low CPU memory footprint.
laplacian.cons: ⚠️ Cons: May mistake flat low-texture scenes (sky, plain walls) or background bokeh for blur.
laplacian.best_for: 💡 Best For: General photography, studio, landscape, and rapid batch filtering.

ai_subject.title: AI Subject Focus (YOLO + ROI + Patch Grid)
ai_subject.how_it_works: 🔬 How It Works: Runs YOLOv8 AI object detection to locate main subjects, then evaluates multi-layer focus energy across subject and eye regions.
ai_subject.detects: 🎯 Detects: Subject-aware sharpness — eyes, head, beak, and face details inside AI bounding boxes.
ai_subject.pros: ✅ Pros: 100% automated AI subject localization with background bokeh immunity.
ai_subject.cons: ⚠️ Cons: Slightly higher per-photo inference time (~25ms).
ai_subject.best_for: 💡 Best For: Wildlife, birding, portraits, macro, and shallow depth-of-field shots.

fft.title: FFT Frequency Analysis (Motion Blur)
fft.how_it_works: 🔬 How It Works: Transforms image into 2D frequency spectrum using Fast Fourier Transform to analyze high-frequency magnitude ratio.
fft.detects: 🎯 Detects: High-frequency motion blur, hand-shake, and subject movement.
fft.pros: ✅ Pros: Accurately isolates directional motion blur that edge operators miss.
fft.cons: ⚠️ Cons: Higher computational cost due to 2D Fourier transforms.
fft.best_for: 💡 Best For: Action shots, sports, and handheld low-light photo culling.

dhash.title: Perceptual Hash (dHash)
dhash.how_it_works: 🔬 How It Works: Generates 64-bit binary perceptual hash bit vectors by comparing adjacent column luminance on 9x8 downsampled images.
dhash.detects: 🎯 Detects: Near-identical photos, crop variations, exposure edits, and burst shots.
dhash.pros: ✅ Pros: Ultra-fast (< 2ms / photo), format-agnostic visual similarity comparison.
dhash.cons: ⚠️ Cons: May miss extreme subject pose variations in high-speed burst shots.
dhash.thresh_guide: 📊 Threshold Guide: 1-4 = Nearly identical, 6-8 = Minor edits / burst shots, >12 = Different photos.
dhash.best_for: 💡 Best For: General duplicate removal and burst sequence culling.

md5.title: Exact File Hash (MD5)
md5.how_it_works: 🔬 How It Works: Computes MD5 checksum on initial file bytes combined with file byte size.
md5.pros: ✅ Pros: Zero false positives. Instantly flags exact duplicate files.
md5.cons: ⚠️ Cons: Misses edited or re-saved JPEG variations.
md5.best_for: 💡 Best For: Cleaning exact byte-duplicate exports and file copies.

burst_time.title: Burst Time Window
burst_time.how_it_works: 🔬 How It Works: Groups consecutive photos captured within a configurable delta time window T using EXIF timestamps.
burst_time.detects: 🎯 Detects: High-speed camera burst sequences based on EXIF capture timestamp.
burst_time.pros: ✅ Pros: Groups rapid burst shots regardless of subject movement or pose changes.
burst_time.cons: ⚠️ Cons: Requires valid EXIF date/time metadata.
burst_time.thresh_guide: 📊 Threshold Guide: 0.5s-1.0s = High-speed sports/birds. 2.0s-3.0s = General burst sequences.
burst_time.best_for: 💡 Best For: Action, sports, and bird flight burst sequences.
